title: Assistant for Fate mod manifest.json
description: Static, non-executable metadata for a mod submitted to fate-mods. Anything executable belongs in bundle.mjs, never here.

id.description: "author@name", globally unique, lowercase kebab-case on both sides of the @.

name.description: "t.name" i18n key (resolved via signRecord) or a plain string.

github.description: GitHub handle — CI binds this to the PR author.

image.description: Optional square artwork filename in the mod directory (png, jpg/jpeg, or webp; max 512×512). CI rejects non-square or oversized files.

languages.description: Must match the files present under translations/.

appVersion.description: Semver range gating the app version.

published.description: Whether the mod appears in the app's Mod Store. Defaults to true when omitted. Unpublished mods are still built and published to gh-pages for dev-mode and install-from-URL use, but are omitted from registry.json.

capabilities.description: "sheetComponents", "dice", and "theme" are fully supported for external mods (SDK >= 1.1.0). "translations" is declared-only for now: the manifest fields exist, but the app does not yet merge translation packs at runtime.

translationTargets.description: For "translations"-capability mods: what this pack translates — "app" (the app's own UI strings) and/or other mod ids. Declarative only until the runtime merge ships; entry/bundle.mjs is still required for now.

config.description: { groups: [], options: [] } — declarative settings schema, structurally validated by the host app, not by this schema.
